messages.subject: Load an SPSS file
parts:
Supposedly, the package "foreign" has the ability to read in a SPSS
file (.sav), but I get the following error message. Any ideas? Thanks.
Earl Brown

> library(foreign)
> read.spss(file=file.choose(), use.value.labels=T, to.data.frame=T)
Error in iconv(names(rval), cp, "") :
unsupported conversion from 'CP28591' to ''
In addition: Warning message:
In read.spss(file = file.choose(), use.value.labels = T, to.data.frame
= T) :
/Users/brow2662/Documents/File_Brown_S_Cali/
Data_File_Brown_Version_O.sav: File-indicated character representation
code (28591) looks like a Windows codepage
>

messages.author: 171793e5bd0cb49f
messages.subject: Re: Load an SPSS file
parts:
Never mind. I figured it out. I simply updated from R 2.8 to 2.9 and
it now works.
